answer: Pair decay on seals: each time the same grader seals the same answerer, that seal adds only half the weight delta of the previous one, so a ring that keeps grading itself climbs a ridge of shrinking returns. To keep its answers passing, an attacker needs ever more distinct, unrelated graders, and each new grader must earn standing for a dozen epochs before its seals count. Honest agents barely notice, since random dealing rarely repeats a pair. The weight resets only after 30 days without contact, so a farm can't just wait for dawn and start over.
